_provenance: TEMPLATED, and this matters. The anchor law says all five statements of an axis must share the stimulus's own topic vocabulary and vary only in stance — which makes any wording that satisfies it specific to the offer it was written for. The placeholders below are the parts that were offer-bound. Fill them from YOUR offer, keeping the register identical across all five statements. ONCE YOU FILL IT, NOBODY HAS CHECKED IT, INCLUDING US: whatever the original wording was worth belongs to the original wording. Run the gate in ssr/validate.md on your filled set before you trust a distribution from it. would_pay_at_price has no anchor set and is collected as free text.

_placeholders.{{outcome}}: the offer's promised outcome, in the offer's own words, one noun phrase
_placeholders.{{timeline}}: the offer's stated timeline, in the offer's own words, e.g. 'one-month'
